adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB update (`prisma.booking.update(...)`) happens before awaiting external side effects: `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` and then `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` (wrapped in a try/catch but still awaited). The diff shows no timeout, abort signal, or background job/queueing, so a slow calendar provider or SMTP send can keep the mutation request open after the DB change has already been committed, creating reliability/UX risk (e.g., request timeout while guests were actually added).
